title: ConvertX
descript: 💾 Self-hosted online file converter. Supports 1000+ formats ⚙️. Packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7: the official Docker Hub image runs as a container on your NAS, keeps its data in the application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/convertxdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.
